name: sandbox-runtime
notes: Forked from carderne/sandbox-runtime (itself derived from Anthropic's sandbox-runtime); local fork adds filesystem.protectNonexistentFiles so embedders can skip bwrap placeholder mounts for not-yet-existing dangerous files. Published locally as @xzzpig/sandbox-runtime; it is a support library for pi-sandbox rather than a Pi plugin, so the record keeps the plain upstream-derived name instead of the pi-* plugin convention.
